parameters: The enemy lies before us at Lemelin Monastery!\! We shall crush the treasonous Temple for harboring the enemies of the Empire of Veridia.\! General Lysander, don't disappoint me.
Yes, your excellency.\! You can count on me.
The Imperial government is invading the Monastery?!\! Unforgivable!
Great Paladin...\| perhaps the government means us no harm!\! Please practice restraint, warriors...
The Prime Minister has been desperate for an excuse to destroy us, and now we've given him one.
Sorry...\| I will take my leave now.
That excuse is me, isn't it, Diana...
This turn of events was inevitable.\! We are much more powerful with your tactical mind, so Donar has given us a blessing.

At least we know what we're up against.\! No more mercenaries, this is the Empire's central army.\! They'll have larger and more organized ranks, and probably some gun units in the mix.\! We don't want to be on the wrong side of gunnery soldiers, their weapons make any armor basically useless.
\n[8], the Temple maintains outposts by the river.\! We should fortify the river to protect the Monastery from needless violence.
Those forts are closer to Casamir's army than they are to us, but it might be worth a shot!\! I guess now'd be a good time to pray to Donar...

This is it, men of Isanter!\! Our chance to stand up to the central government's tyranny is now!\! We cannot abide this disgraceful action by the Prime Minister.\! Attack the Imperial Army and reinforce the Temple!!
You know what to do, men!\! The Temple will not fall today!\! We join Isanter and resolve to bring the Prime Minister to heel!
That's Duke Lothair's army, and General Lysander has defected!\! Damn, good timing, fella.
Donar has answered our call - the Temple shall never perish.
What treachery...\| the Duke of Isanter must be a fool of the highest order to make an enemy of me!
